messages:
eli (Support): Pasting a ticket — new customer signed up via SSO (sophia-inc) but no API key visible in their project. Console shows key created under an internal project 'shadow-service-482'. Anyone seen this routing flip before?
provisioner-bot: Provisioner created service credential svc-key-zz123 in project shadow-service-482 (provisioner-id=8421)
marco (Auth): Looking now. Can you DM me the tenant ID and the SSO trace? Might be an OIDC claim mapping mismatch.
eli (Support): Sent DM with SSO trace. Key creation log excerpt: 
```
{ "time":"2026-03-15T18:12:03Z", "tenant":"sophia-inc", "org_claim":"sophia-prod", "project_assigned":"shadow-service-482", "provisioner_job":8421 }
{ "time":"2026-03-15T18:12:03Z", "mapper":"okta-mapper", "claim_verified":false }
{ "time":"2026-03-15T18:12:04Z", "binder":"project-binder", "bound_project":"shadow-service-482" }
```
anna (Eng): That looks like a race: mapper hasn't confirmed org mapping when binder picks a temporary project. Binder currently falls back to the default internal staging project if claim verification lags.
liam (Customer Success): Repro steps from customer: created org via Okta SAML, accepted invite, console shows no keys. They tried API call and got 401 (key not found).
marco (Auth): Short-term fix: I'll perform a manual rebind and rotate the key. Plan: rebind svc-key-zz123 -> proj-sophia-918, then rotate and revoke the old key. Will add audit entries. ETA ~30m.
eli (Support): Please paste exact admin commands you will run so I can include in the ticket. Also post in incidents channel after you run it.
marco (Auth): Running these via adminctl: 
```
adminctl rebind-key --key svc-key-zz123 --from-project shadow-service-482 --to-project proj-sophia-918 --actor marco
adminctl rotate-key --key svc-key-zz123 --new-key svc-key-rot-987 --actor marco
```
Will create audit: rebind-job-9922.
deploy-bot: Rebind job 9922 started.
deploy-bot: Rebind job 9922 completed successfully.
liam (Customer Success): Customer confirmed — key appears in their project now and their API calls return 200. They rotated the key on their side.
anna (Eng): We should add a guard to the provisioning flow: delay binder until mapper confirms claim or use a retry/backoff instead of falling back to internal project. I'll open a follow-up ticket to implement a guard and add a regression test.
eli (Support): Great, please tag infra and auth. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
